exact_results.classical_flow: the polynomial Hamilton ODE is global for finite data because energy is conserved and sublevel sets are compact
exact_results.critical_dynamics: under the inserted inertial law, z=1 and every scalar valley has c_star=2*sqrt(c/chi)
exact_results.cubic_umklapp: the eight-node set is exactly closed under triple sums modulo the reciprocal lattice for every N divisible by four
exact_results.finite_quantum_symmetry: the unique ground state is translation and phi-to-minus-phi invariant, so one-point order vanishes at fixed N
exact_results.harmonic_speed_bound: for r>0 the gradient exists and |grad_k omega|<=2*sqrt(c/chi) at every k; for r=0 the bound holds off the nodes and omega is globally Lipschitz with the same directional-speed envelope
exact_results.low_energy_concentration: ||P_Qperp phi||^2 <= 2 DeltaH/(c delta_N) and sum_x(phi_x^2+r/g)^2 <=4 DeltaH/g for r<0
exact_results.quantum_operator: H_N=-(hbar^2/(2chi))*Delta+U_r has finite configuration dimension V on the infinite-dimensional Hilbert space L2(R^V), compact resolvent and one strictly positive simple ground state by standard prior-art theorems
exact_results.r_negative_minimizers: pi=0, B_i phi=0 and phi_x^2=-r/g at every site
exact_results.r_negative_minimum: min H_r=-V*r^2/(4g), strictly below H_r(0,0)=0 in the identical finite Hamiltonian convention
exact_results.r_nonnegative: phi=pi=0 is the unique classical stationary point and global minimum
exact_results.raw_quantum_energy: E0(r) is strictly increasing and crosses the declared raw zero once, but any additive constant moves that crossing
